steps.t: 🏛 File the Illinois LLC ($150) — this unlocks everything below

steps.why: The liability shield, and the bank will ask for it. Online, approved in days. It is the first domino: LLC → EIN → business bank account → Meta verifies the business → WhatsApp sends straight from Daraja HQ. Approval takes a few days, so filing before Thursday means it can come through while you are away.
how: ilsos.gov → Business Services → File Articles of Organization (form LLC-5.5).
Name: Daraja Studio LLC · member-managed · you (add Diane if you want her on it).
Pay $150 → save the confirmation PDF into Daraja Studio/Legal/ on your Mac.

steps.t: 🧠 Switch on the Zuri manager's AI: add the Anthropic key in Supabase
steps.where: At the Mac, ten minutes, a card on the Anthropic account.
steps.why: The Zuri manager already runs on rules: morning lists, chasing what's overdue, the Friday summary. With an Anthropic key it writes them like a person: each person's “your day” list, the nudges, the praise (“14 follow-ups this week, asante!”), and the Friday report. About $3–6 a month, a Zuri cost. You make the key and paste it yourself; I never see it.
how: Anthropic console → API keys → Create key, name it “Zuri manager”. Copy it.
Supabase → Zuri Fiber (the REAL project, not Training) → Edge Functions → Secrets → Add new: name ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, paste the key, Save.
Tell me “Zuri key added”. I run one test morning list and show it to you before anyone gets one.

steps.where: A credit card. About 12 minutes — a little longer than Namecheap because of one extra step.
steps.why: Do this before the Meta step: a business website and email on your own domain help Meta verify Daraja Studio. It also makes your free Cloudflare account, which the phone alerts (next row) and the WhatsApp relay (last row) use too. You asked which one. Cloudflare, and it is not close. They sell domains AT COST with no markup, so it is about $10 a year forever — Namecheap shows a cheap first year then renews near $20. Over five years that is $55 against $110 for the identical domain. Cloudflare also gives you WHOIS privacy free and always on, which keeps your home address out of the public domain record; Namecheap sells that as an extra. And you will want Cloudflare anyway when the store moves off the GitHub address onto your own.
how: Go to cloudflare.com and make a free account. This is the extra step: Cloudflare will not sell you a domain until you have an account.
In the dashboard, find Domain Registration → Register Domain.
Search darajastudio.com. If it is taken, take darajastudio.co instead — then text me which one you got.
Buy ONE year. Turn auto-renew ON — a lapsed domain can be bought by anybody within days.
Ignore every upsell. You do not need their email, hosting or extra SSL. Privacy protection is already included and already on.
Tell me it is done. Pointing the store at it is a job for me, and takes about ten minutes.

steps.t: 🔔 Phone alerts for My Scores: make the free Cloudflare key (then I finish it)
steps.where: Your Mac or phone, about 8 minutes. No payment details needed.
steps.why: Everything is built and tested: when a starter is out and the game is about to start, My Scores pushes a message to the phone even with the app closed. It needs one small free relay on Cloudflare (a free account, no card). I can't make an account for you, and the relay needs a key from it. You make the key, copy it, and tell me. I never see it on screen: I save it from your clipboard and deploy.
how: Open Cloudflare sign-up (link) and make a free account with your email. Confirm the email.
Open the API Tokens page (link). Tap Create Token, then Use template next to “Edit Cloudflare Workers”.
Under Account Resources choose your account. Under Zone Resources choose All zones. Tap Continue to summary, then Create Token.
Tap the Copy button next to the token. Do not paste it anywhere.

Come back and say “token copied”. I save it and finish. Then on your iPhone: open My Scores, Share, Add to Home Screen, open it from the icon, Assistant Manager, Kickoff alerts, Turn on, Send me a test.

steps.t: 💬 WhatsApp for Jerry HQ — Meta needs the business verified first (so: LLC → EIN → verify)
steps.where: The LLC approval and the EIN letter (the two steps just above/below this one).
steps.why: We built and tried everything on 2 Oct. The result: Meta restricts every WhatsApp business account (the test one and the new real “Daraja Studio” one) until the business is VERIFIED, and until then you cannot add any phone number. Verification needs papers in the legal business name — the Articles of Organization and the EIN letter. Daraja Studio is not a legal entity yet, which is why the LLC and EIN steps in this section come first. Until then HQ works with tap-to-send (it opens WhatsApp with your words typed in; you press send).
how: Do the LLC and the EIN steps in this section first.

Then, in Meta Business Suite: Settings → Security Center → Business verification → Start verification. The legal name must match your LLC papers exactly (e.g. “Daraja Studio LLC”); update Business info to match first.
When Meta approves it (usually a few days), say “let's finish WhatsApp” — I take over the clicking for the number, token, relay and webhook; you only do the code and the terms.

steps.t: ☁️ Cloudflare relay — so WhatsApp replies land in HQ by themselves
steps.where: A free Cloudflare account; Meta's App secret (you paste it yourself); about 20 minutes. Say “let's do the relay” and I walk you through it one step at a time.
steps.why: Only after Meta has verified the business and a real number is added. A free Cloudflare account hosts a tiny relay (already written) that catches replies from Meta and passes them to HQ. Then “Send on WhatsApp” goes straight from HQ and replies show up under each person.
how: Say “let's do the relay”.
